scope: scoped current-code diagnostics; not canonical worker acceptance

limitations: Instrumented small buddy route only; not canonical acceptance or a heap retainer snapshot.
Expanded JSON bytes count repeated references repeatedly; no whole store is serialized.
Container model = 32 bytes per object/array + 16 bytes per object property + 8 bytes per array element.
Container model excludes V8 string allocation, hidden classes, Map/index storage and runtime overhead; it is not actual heap.
String code units count references, not unique allocated strings; string sharing cannot be established by JavaScript identity.
GC checkpoints perturb duration and allocation; measured process RSS/heap include instrumentation.
